title: KS-762: Was the 2026-09-05 APP_DB_PASSWORD rotation done, and may ':?required' be released?
bluf: You ruled 2026-09-03 to keep the ':-' defaults and to rotate on 2026-09-05 09:00, with the ':?required' switch re-raised only after rotation and with notice to Peter and Stuart. The seat on 09-06 found the committed literal unchanged and the rotation date two days lapsed, and could not tell from any system whether it ran (unverified). The switch breaks every existing local stack and fresh clone until each person sets APP_DB_PASSWORD. Releasing it means telling Peter and Stuart (team communication). It is a local-dev compose password per the ticket.

sources.quote: The rotation on 2026-09-05 09:00 is Kam's deploy step
I have not asserted either way

options.label: Rotation done: release ':?required' now, with notice to Peter and Stuart
options.detail: Agent build + team message. Breaks existing local stacks until each .env gets the variable.
